params.name: location_id
params.description: Unique ID of a particular location. This is generated by Punchh. If both `location_id` and `store_number` are provided, `location_id` will be given priority.

params.name: store_number
params.description: Unique store number provided by the business. If both `location_id` and `store_number` are provided, `location_id` will be given priority.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number. If this parameter is not provided with the request, the default is to return all. If `page` is specified, only that page will be returned using the value of `per` as the number of locations returned on that page.

params.name: per
params.description: Number of locations per page. If `per` is not specified, the default is 25.

items.docs: Returns a list of locations and their details. The `page` and `per` request parameters determine the page(s) returned and the number of locations returned per page.
